title: 小文件问题：NameNode 元数据开销对比
expected_output:
1GB as one big file -> blocks: 8 meta_bytes: 1200
1GB as 1KB files   -> files: 1048576 meta_bytes: 157286400
meta_overhead_ratio: 131072.0
code:
BLOCK = 128 * 1024 * 1024
META = 150
total = 1024 * 1024 * 1024   # 1 GB
big_blocks = (total + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK
small_files = total // 1024   # 1KB 小文件
print("1GB as one big file -> blocks:", big_blocks, "meta_bytes:", big_blocks * META)
print("1GB as 1KB files   -> files:", small_files, "meta_bytes:", small_files * META)
print("meta_overhead_ratio:", round((small_files * META) / (big_blocks * META), 1))
